description:
​We are team Duality, building a web-based Space Mission Design Game for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge!
​Project Concept: An interactive web game where players act as Mission Commanders, managing resources (Budget, Fuel, Mass, Oxygen) to launch successful space missions while making decision-based choices.
​Tech Stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript / React.

​Looking For: Creative minds interested in frontend design, UI/UX, or game logic!
